# CADCraft web

## Description

The CADCraft web interface's design system: the tokens, the thirteen canonical components and the rules the interface is built from, serving the SolidJS app in `apps/ui` over the cadcraft-wasm facade. Foundation: hand-rolled — the system is the app's own, measured from the running Cursor 3.27.22, and no registry item ships it.

## Importing a component

```tsx
import { Button } from "./ui/Button"; // from a file in src/, or the registry's import path
```

## The one rule

New UI uses a registry component (`docs/registry.json`) and the tokens in `src/tokens.css`. If none fits, open a gate before writing one — do not restyle a native element.

## Priority order

When two rules conflict, the earlier wins:

1. Accessibility — keyboard paths, focus, contrast, target size.
2. The tokens — a value that has a token uses the token.
3. The existing components — reuse beats a new variant.
4. The scales — a gap, a radius, a size is a ladder step.
5. Polish — spacing, alignment, motion last.

## The page shell

The app's real shell, in order (from `src/app.tsx`):

```tsx
<div class="app">                     <!-- a grid of four rows: auto, auto, the rest, auto -->
  <TopBar menu={<MenuBar … />} … />   <!-- the title bar, 35px: the menus (one Main menu key under 900px), the command centre, three layout keys -->
  <ToolStrip … />                     <!-- the tool strip, 28px: the drawing tools, an overflow menu for the ones that do not fit -->
  <div class="workspace">             <!-- a flex row: sidebar, editor, assistant -->
    <aside class="sidebar">           <!-- left, 252px: LayersPanel over PropertiesPanel -->
    <div class="editor">              <!-- the middle, what is left -->
      <LayoutTabs … />                <!-- the editor tabs (Model and the layouts) -->
      <main class="stage"><CanvasView … /></main>
      <CommandLine … />               <!-- the bottom panel -->
    </div>
    <AssistantPane … />               <!-- right, 340px by default, resizable -->
  </div>
  <StatusBar … />                     <!-- the status bar, one 22px line -->
  <CommandPalette … />                <!-- a dialog over the page (Ctrl+Shift+P) -->
</div>
```

Every part but the editor can be hidden (the title bar's layout keys, View's commands). With the assistant open under 900px the sidebar steps aside, and under 560px the assistant takes the whole workspace.

## When to ask

Ask only for an amount or a limit the task did not give (a new size, a new duration, a new colour role). Decide everything else from these pages and say what you chose.

## Reject list

- No second brand hue; `--accent` is the one action colour.
- No looping or ambient animation; motion is state feedback only.
- No raw values where a token exists; no px in a control's box that is not on a ladder.
- No icon fonts, sprites or third-party iconography; glyphs are drawn in `src/icons.ts`.
- No component copies inside `docs/system/examples`; examples import the real component.

## Checking the work

`bun run check`, from `apps/ui/` — typecheck, the drift check, the spec check and the docs check, in one command.

## Foundations
- [Colors](docs/generated/colors.md): One base colour at an alpha ladder over a few near-black surfaces in dark, mirrored in light: colour is a signal, never decoration.
- [Icons](docs/generated/icons.md): Every icon is drawn in code as an SVG path on a 24×24 grid and takes its colour from the surrounding ink (currentColor); no icon font, sp...
- [Motion](docs/generated/motion.md): Four durations and three easings: motion is fast, short and never decorative — it confirms a state change and gets out of the way.
- [Radius](docs/generated/radius.md): The corner ladder (2–5px for controls, 12 and 14px for the assistant's blocks and popovers, full round for pills), the one hairline width...
- [Spacing](docs/generated/spacing.md): One gap scale in even steps and one control-height ladder: every inset, gap and control size in the chrome is a token from these two ladd...
- [Typography](docs/generated/typography.md): Two families (the system UI stack and the mono stack) and one scale of four sizes on screen: 11px for section labels, counts and key caps...

## Components
- [Button](docs/generated/components/button.md): It runs one action the moment its label says so: it never navigates and never holds a value.
- [Checkbox](docs/generated/components/checkbox.md): It holds one yes-or-no value the caller owns, and can say that the things it stands for disagree.
- [Chip](docs/generated/components/chip.md): It shows one compact fact, a keyword or a suggestion, and it only acts when the caller gives it a handler.
- [Field](docs/generated/components/field.md): It takes one line of text and hands every keystroke back to the caller, who owns the value.
- [IconButton](docs/generated/components/icon-button.md): It runs one action drawn as a single glyph, and its title is both its accessible name and the hint a sighted person reads.
- [Kbd](docs/generated/components/kbd.md): It shows the key or shortcut that runs the action beside it, as a fact to read and never as a control.
- [Row](docs/generated/components/row.md): It is the full-width clickable band of a list: a layer, a command in a listbox or an item of a menu, marked current when it is the select...
- [SectionLabel](docs/generated/components/section-label.md): It names a panel's section as a real heading, so a screen reader can jump between the sections by heading.
- [Select](docs/generated/components/select.md): It lets the user pick one value from a short, known list, and hands the pick back to the caller, who owns the value.
- [Tab](docs/generated/components/tab.md): It brings one view of a strip to the front: a layout over the drawing or a chat in the assistant, marked selected when it is the one show...
- [TextArea](docs/generated/components/textarea.md): It takes several lines of text, grows to hold them up to a limit, and hands every edit back to the caller, who owns the text.
- [Toggle](docs/generated/components/toggle.md): It switches one setting on or off in place, under a name that never changes, and says which it is through its pressed state.
- [Tooltip](docs/generated/components/tooltip.md): It is the layer's one hint: a small box beside a control under the pointer or under keyboard focus, saying what the control does not alre...
